result.title: FALCA: Falsification-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Hierarchical Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Deep Search Agents
result.comment: 19 pages, 20 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://douzj-llm.github.io/FALCA/
result.summary: Long-horizon deep search requires LLM agents to iteratively decompose complex information needs, gather evidence from external sources, and maintain a reliable research state under multiple constraints. A central challenge is that early mistakes can be amplified over the search trajectory: agents may anchor on an incorrect candidate, collect partially supporting evidence, overlook contradictions, and accumulate errors that misguide subsequent reasoning. We propose FALCA, a falsification-aware framework that formulates deep search as a propose-falsify process. FALCA adopts a collaborative Searcher-Falsifier architecture, where the Searcher proposes candidate answers or sub-answers, while independent Falsifiers actively seek counterevidence, check unmet constraints, identify conflicts, and produce concise falsification reports for research-state revision. To strengthen this loop, we introduce falsification-aware training, combining SFT warmup on falsification trajectories with agentic RL based on parallel rollouts and hierarchical credit assignment over research stages, state transitions, and actions. Experiments on five search benchmarks show that FALCA improves long-horizon deep search performance over backbone and harness ablations, while reducing confirmation bias and error accumulation through more effective falsification and research-state revision.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FALCA，把长程深度搜索表述为「提议—证伪」过程：Searcher 提出候选答案，独立 Falsifier 主动搜集反证并生成证伪报告以修订研究状态，并配合证伪轨迹 SFT 预热与基于分层信用分配的 agentic RL 训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯文本检索智能体、不涉及视觉，但其「主动寻找反证以筛选证据」「研究状态修订」与跨阶段、状态转移、动作的分层信用分配，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、latent 状态更新及轨迹贡献分配问题。
